summary: The store's claim fold reaches each domain projection through an ordered projector registry (store/projectors.rs) instead of naming it, with a test that pins the order per phase and per claim kind

replay.detail: Every phase calls the same projections in the same order as before; the registry only lists them. Replay, append and incremental projection derive the same rows.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged; the checkpoint proof's replay runs the same rebuild list.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, harness, route, CLI output or exit code changes.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
